title: Edit
description: An edit request (apply.patch). This is the trust-spine: payload.undoLabel is MANDATORY and payload.operations MUST be a non-empty array (PROJECT.md / AGENTS.md line 17: 'undo labels mandatory'). Frozen from docs/seed.md §Edit request example + §data model patch operations.
$comment: TRUST-SPINE ENFORCEMENT: payload.undoLabel is non-optional at the schema level — the bridge refuses any edit without it. The operation element shape IS the primitive discriminated union (add_note/remove_note/update_note_field) $ref'd from patch.schema.json#/$defs/PrimitiveOp (D-01 hybrid catalog — primitives canonical). The bridge resolves the cross-file $ref by $id at runtime (all schemas registered in one Ajv instance). Phase 3 (EDIT-01) tightened operations.items from the Phase-1 placeholder {type:object} to the primitive union. undoLabel + non-empty operations stay MANDATORY. D-03 self-inverting primitives + bitwig-capabilities.md §1 (no labelled-undo API) together make the daemon-authoritative revert path the spine.

id.description: Edit requests ARE requests — correlation id REQUIRED.

payload.description: Patch payload. undoLabel + operations are both REQUIRED (trust-spine).

undoLabel.description: MANDATORY non-empty undo label. PROJECT.md trust model: every applied patch gets an undo label. Enforced at schema level.

operations.description: Non-empty array of primitive patch operations (add_note/remove_note/update_note_field). Element shape tightened (Phase 3, EDIT-01) to the patch.schema.json#/$defs/PrimitiveOp union — the cross-file $ref is resolved by $id at runtime when both schemas are registered in one Ajv instance.
